title: Rigorous Diffraction from Two Slits
exact_target: Find an explicit rigorous solution and asymptotic analysis for diffraction through two finite planar slits.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 8100008 (AMR-080-0008). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Percy Deift, Some Open Problems in Random Matrix Theory and the Theory of Integrable Systems. II, SIGMA 13 (2017), 016, final two-slit question.
Primary full-text formulation and 2017 historical progress discussion.

status_qualification: The source does not fix slit geometry, screen boundary condition or incident field in its short formulation; these must be stated for any proposed solution. The Helmholtz description is explanatory context, not an invented choice of Dirichlet or Neumann target.
